conviction_note: The H1 profit line should clear the company's own H1 plan by a visible margin (Q1 OP 599 already 67% of the 900 H1 plan, Q2 sales +3.7% per 月次 against a quarter that needs only 301 of OP vs 393 a year ago), but that is computable from public documents and has sat in the price since July, and the full-year plan needs H2 OP to double after last year's raised guide was missed by 29%, so a hold, not a raise, is the likely forecast decision; impact_sum +0.6 and the scaled +0.48 (p_up 58 x abs 3.0) agree in sign and size.

positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% disclosed (no position >=0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 0.17x (kabutan, https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=8200, read 2026-10-09 10:19 JST): margin shorts ~6x margin longs, but this is a heavy 株主優待 name (Feb/Aug record dates) and a low ratio here is most plausibly 優待 cross hedges, which are not forced buyers; I could not read the balance history (kabutan margin page returned a CAPTCHA). No option skew exists. Lean in baseline +0.43, mostly the margin-overhang component; 20d run-up -0.98%, 5d +2.2%, +1.6% on the morning of the print.

findings.finding: H1 operating profit should land well above the company's H1 plan of 900m: Q1 OP was 599m (+51% y/y, margin 5.2% vs 3.6%, cost of sales down in yen on +2.9% sales), Q2 all-store sales ran 104.5/104.4/102.2% for Jun/Jul/Aug, and Q2 only needs 301m of OP against 393m in the same quarter last year, so even a flat Q2 margin gives ~1,000m and a Q1-like margin ~1,150m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY27 profit beat (OP +51%) on 2026-07-10 15:30: +5.09% next session (baseline), 2201 -> 2388 over two sessions then faded back to ~2300 within three weeks (Yahoo tape). H1 FY26 beat with FY raise on 2025-10-10: '大幅反発' (+5.5% in baseline).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: Q1 has been public since July and the stock has gone sideways at ~2,260-2,360 since, which is what a market that already credits the H1 beat looks like. What is not public is the Q2 margin (月次 show sales and traffic, not cost), and there is no analyst on the name (kabuyoho consensus blank), so nobody has published an H1 profit number above the plan; kabutan's own Q1 note framed the 64% progress as BELOW the 3-year average, i.e. the headline machinery did not flag an H1 beat.
findings.independence: Q1 短信 and kabutan Q1 note (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8200&b=k202607100046, 2026-07-10) for the Q1 numbers and the H1 plan; the 月次 PDF is a different document. Kabutan finance page (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=8200) for last year's Q2 OP 393m.

findings.finding: The full-year plan (OP 2,200m, ordinary 2,040m) implies H2 OP of ~1,100-1,300m against 628m in H2 last year, and last year the company raised its FY guide at H1 (OP 1,700 -> 1,990) and then delivered 1,418, so a repeat raise is unlikely and the probable 'full-year unchanged' leaves the H1 beat reading as timing rather than an upgrade.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY raise + dividend +1 yen + medium-term plan at H1 2025-10-10: +5.5% (baseline), kabutan '大幅反発'. No FY revision at H1 2024-10-11 (FY25 plan held all year): +1.01% (baseline, estimated date). Initial FY27 guide on 2026-04-10: -2.07%.
findings.why_not_priced: If the market expected a hold it would not have bid the stock +1.6% into the print this morning; the one equivalent print in memory (Oct 2025) came with a raise, a dividend increase and a medium-term plan, so the template retail holders carry is the raise. A hold is not a cut, which is why this is small.
findings.independence: Kabutan finance page revision table (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=8200) and the 2025-10-14 MINKABU note on the raise (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=8200&b=n202510140480); the 2026-04-10 kabutan note confirms FY26 OP 1,418 actual.

findings.finding: Cabbage, a core input for a chain that uses only domestic vegetables, ran well above normal through August into September 2026 (ALIC: retail 152% of normal on 2026-08-14, wholesale 124% of normal on 2026-09-05) after a hot, dry July-August, a cost headwind on the last month of Q2 and on the H2 commentary.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean history isolating vegetable cost; Q4 FY26 (Dec-Feb) margin fell to 2.4% from 3.6% and the stock fell -2.07% at the FY print.
findings.source_date: 2026-09-08 (令和8年9月8日, read in the document)
findings.why_not_priced: A commodity proxy no one maps to this P&L; partly contracted farming buffers it and it touches one month of the half, so it is sized small and as a proxy.
findings.independence: MAFF Tohoku outlook for September cabbage 'high vs normal' (https://www.maff.go.jp/tohoku/press/tokusan/attach/pdf/260831-1.pdf), snippet only.

baseline_tension: Agrees mildly with the baseline lean (+0.43, margin component) and the +2.2% 5-day run-up; the strongest positive the release could carry is a FY raise plus a dividend increase as in Oct 2025, which I looked for and judge unlikely; the strongest negative is a held FY plan with a cost-heavy H2 commentary.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 (negatives on public series -> p_up toward 50) touches F2 and F3, both already small and neither carrying the lean, and the symmetric logic for F1 was already in its size; rule 2 (check the sign, look for the positive) was done in baseline_tension; p_up stays 58.
